column1: # Proposed Kannada display labels (BUILD_SPEC §7.5 §1). NOT authoritative.
# tier=police   : OSM amenity=police carried its own name:kn. Transformation "normalized".
# tier=locality : a locality name:kn composed with a constant station suffix. Transformation "derived".
# tier=review   : no agreed match. Renders in English until a human supplies a name.
# Nothing here is transliterated or invented. An empty name_kn is the correct
# outcome when the source is silent — do not fill one in by guessing.
